grammar.pattern: 名词性谓语：年龄、日期等
grammar.explanation: 我二十二岁 and 今天星期三 can stand without 是 in familiar age/date contexts. This is not a rule to delete 是 from every identification: 她是商人 remains a normal noun classification. Negative age/date claims normally use 不是: 今天不是星期二. Ask what is being stated before expanding an omitted verb.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她商人。这里是在介绍身份。
commonMistakes.why: Keep 是 in this neutral identity introduction; short age/date patterns do not license every noun predicate.

grammar.purpose: Interpret topic, nominal predicate and scope
grammar.explanation: 今天星期三 has the topic 今天 and nominal predicate 星期三. 她今年二十二岁 states her age this year, not her birthday or birthplace. 这本书三十五块 gives a price in context. Use 不是 to reject a stated value and supply the actual one; these patterns do not establish unrelated facts.

examples.py: tā jīn nián èr shí èr suì .
zhè běn shū sān shí wǔ kuài .

examples.zh: 今天不是星期二，是星期三。
examples.py: jīn tiān bù shì xīng qī èr , shì xīng qī sān .
examples.en: Today is not Tuesday; it is Wednesday.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她今年二十二岁，所以知道生日是哪天。
commonMistakes.right: 她今年二十二岁，生日是哪天还没说。
commonMistakes.why: An age does not identify the birthday date.

lines.zh: 我今年二十二岁，过去在南方长大。
lines.py: wǒ jīn nián èr shí èr suì , guò qu zài nán fāng zhǎng dà .
lines.en: I am twenty-two this year and grew up in the south.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我二十三岁，在北方这个省长大。
lines.py: wǒ èr shí sān suì , zài běi fāng zhè gè shěng zhǎng dà .
lines.en: I am twenty-three and grew up in this northern province.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你姐姐是商人，你也是吗？
lines.py: nǐ jiě jie shì shāng rén , nǐ yě shì ma ?
lines.en: Your elder sister is a businessperson; are you too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，我还是学生。我们的故事要分开。
lines.py: bù shì , wǒ hái shi xué sheng . wǒ men de gù shì yào fēn kāi .
lines.en: No, I am still a student; keep our stories separate.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天星期三，见面时间变了吗？
lines.py: jīn tiān xīng qī sān , jiàn miàn shí jiān biàn le ma ?
lines.en: Today is Wednesday; has the meeting time changed?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没变，三点在中心门口见。
lines.py: méi biàn , sān diǎn zài zhōng xīn mén kǒu jiàn .
lines.en: It has not changed: meet at the centre entrance at three.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我得了三分，三分以上包括我吗？
lines.py: wǒ dé le sān fēn , sān fēn yǐ shàng bāo kuò wǒ ma ?
lines.en: I scored three; does at least three include me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 包括。但你姐姐的结果没说，不能替她选。
lines.py: bāo kuò . dàn nǐ jiě jie de jié guǒ méi shuō , bù néng tì tā xuǎn .
lines.en: Yes. Your sister’s result has not been stated; you cannot choose for her.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天星期三，我们三点在中心门口见。
lines.py: jīn tiān xīng qī sān , wǒ men sān diǎn zài zhōng xīn mén kǒu jiàn .
lines.en: Today is Wednesday; we meet at the centre entrance at three.

lines.zh: 一位今年二十二岁，另一位二十三岁。
lines.py: yī wèi jīn nián èr shí èr suì , lìng yī wèi èr shí sān suì .
lines.en: One person is twenty-two this year and the other twenty-three.

lines.zh: 两个人在不同地方长大，不能说背景一样。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén zài bù tóng dì fāng zhǎng dà , bù néng shuō bèi jǐng yī yàng .
lines.en: They grew up in different places; their backgrounds cannot be called identical.

lines.zh: 姐姐是商人，弟弟是学生，身份也要分开。
lines.py: jiě jie shì shāng rén , dì di shì xué sheng , shēn fèn yě yào fēn kāi .
lines.en: The elder sister is a businessperson and the younger brother a student; keep their roles separate too.

lines.zh: 她选了三张照片，有人说很像，有人说不一样。
lines.py: tā xuǎn le sān zhāng zhào piān , yǒu rén shuō hěn xiàng , yǒu rén shuō bù yī yàng .
lines.en: She chose three photographs; some say they are alike and others say they differ.

lines.zh: 过去的小组变成五个人，许多信息还没确认。
lines.py: guò qu de xiǎo zǔ biàn chéng wǔ gè rén , xǔ duō xìn xī hái méi què rèn .
lines.en: The earlier group became five people; much information is still unconfirmed.

lines.zh: 有人在市里卖书，那本漂亮的书三十五块。
lines.py: yǒu rén zài shì lǐ mài shū , nà běn piào liàng de shū sān shí wǔ kuài .
lines.en: Someone sells books in the city; that attractive book costs thirty-five yuan.

lines.zh: 一个人的结果不是所有人的结果，先看事实再得出结论。
lines.py: yī gè rén de jié guǒ bù shì suǒ yǒu rén de jié guǒ , xiān kàn shì shí zài dé chū jié lùn .
lines.en: One person’s result is not everyone’s; examine facts before drawing conclusions.

lines.zh: 今天星期三，门口三点见。
lines.py: jīn tiān xīng qī sān , mén kǒu sān diǎn jiàn .
lines.en: Today is Wednesday; meet at the entrance at three.

lines.zh: 你从北方来，我从南方来。
lines.py: nǐ cóng běi fāng lái , wǒ cóng nán fāng lái .
lines.en: You come from the north and I from the south.

lines.zh: 过去不一样，现在坐一边。
lines.py: guò qu bù yī yàng , xiàn zài zuò yī biān .

lines.zh: 一页写两人，不把故事连。
lines.py: yī yè xiě liǎng rén , bù bǎ gù shì lián .
lines.en: One page contains two people; do not merge their stories.

lines.zh: 先听你说完，再把我的讲。
lines.py: xiān tīng nǐ shuō wán , zài bǎ wǒ de jiǎng .
lines.en: Hear your account out before telling mine.

lines.zh: 朋友可以像，结果别乱猜。
lines.py: péng you kě yǐ xiàng , jié guǒ bié luàn cāi .
lines.en: Friends may resemble each other; do not guess their results.
